purpose: Curated allowlist + normalization profile for turning very large M3U/Xtream IPTV lineups into a cable-style EPG.

scope.default_focus: Canada + USA, English + French Canada, sports-heavy
scope.note: Counts are targets, not quotas. Keep fewer channels rather than expose duplicates or poor feeds.

priority: Network + market match for local affiliates
Public EPG fallback such as IPTV-org/EPGShare where legally/technically appropriate
epg_policy.reason: This JSON defines what channels belong in the guide; live program schedules should be resolved at runtime.

core.description: Most recognizable Canadian/US broadcast, entertainment, sports, news and kids channels.

expanded.description: Recommended default: cable-style lineup plus major US locals, specialty, regional sports and premium channels.

max_curated.description: Expanded plus selected optional UK/music/FAST channels; still capped at 1,000 visible channels.

deduplication.note: A 1080p stream that is stable should outrank an unreliable 4K stream.

canada.strategy: Keep major-market affiliates; prefer the user's nearest market in UI ordering.

usa.strategy: Keep the major markets in this file instead of every ABC/CBS/NBC/FOX/CW/PBS affiliate in the country.
